description: This file defines the 'CodeIndexOrchestrator' class responsible for managing the code indexing workflow, including starting/stopping watchers, indexing files, handling errors, and coordinating with other services.

classes.name: CodeIndexOrchestrator
classes.description: Manages the code indexing workflow, coordinating between different services and managers, including starting/stopping watchers, indexing files, handling errors, and cancellation.

methods.name: updateBatchSegmentThreshold
methods.description: Updates the batch segment threshold for both scanner and file watcher.

methods.name: _startWatcher
methods.description: Initializes and starts the file watcher, setting up event handlers for batch processing events.

methods.name: startIndexing
methods.description: Begins the indexing process, performing initial or incremental scans, and starting the watcher.

methods.name: stopWatcher
methods.description: Stops the file watcher and cleans up resources.

methods.name: cancelIndexing
methods.description: Gracefully cancels ongoing indexing work, stops watcher, and updates UI state.

methods.name: clearIndexData
methods.description: Clears all index data, including stopping watcher, clearing vector store, and resetting cache.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the indexing system.
